🚨 A 6-year-old girl was rescued alive after spending approximately 55 to 60 hours trapped beneath flood debris in Timure, Rasuwa District, Nepal. Members of Nepal’s Armed Police Force worked through mud and wreckage before reaching the child, identified in reports as Manisha, and safely pulling her from the destruction. 🙏 The girl received immediate medical assistance and was reportedly transferred to Kathmandu for further care. Wildest Festival Yet 🤯🐮 Only in Nepal will you find a festival to do with people passing away, cows, dancing, cross dressing and loads more.  Welcome to Gai Jatra - which literally translates to cow festival.  There’s a huge historical story behind it which is too long to explain here but essentially people originally took cows through the street as a way of saying  final goodbye to their loved ones but now for practicality they use these giant effigies call Tahamacha.  Hospitality of Nepal is off to a fantastic start absolutely loving it here but it feels like there is a festival everyday in Nepal - full video on this will be out on the Youchooobz at some point.  #nepaltiktok #nepal #kathmandu #gaijatra
